authors: L. J. Radziemski, R. Engleman, Jr., J. W. Brault
title: Fourier-transform-spectroscopy measurements in the spectra of neutral lithium, 6Li I and 7Li I (Li I)
method: Fourier-transform emission spectroscopy of hollow-cathode lamps (isotopically enriched), level values from a fit to 34 lines plus literature data for 2p
uncertainty: per level (common column for both isotopes unless a 7Li value has its own in parentheses): 1e-3 cm^-1 for n<=5 s/p, up to 0.05 cm^-1 for 6f
conversion: Only the rows of 7Li: 28 rows of other isotopes left out.
Not exported, fine structure not resolved (no J): 3 rows (7Li 6d 2D3/2,5/2, 7Li 6f 2F5/2,7/2, 7Li 5g 2G7/2,9/2).

Energies from '7Li 2s 2S1/2, centre of gravity of ground-state hfs', energy zero: Table IV caption: level values 'calculated from the center of gravity of the hyperfine structure of the ground state'.
caveats: low-lying levels only (n<=6), relevant as anchors for the low-n end of quantum-defect fits
2p values are taken from Sansonetti et al. 1995 (footnote a), not measured here
some high levels possibly Stark-perturbed in the high-current source (stated in the text)
